claims.description: We will see basis what we disclose on a quarterly basis or whatever is the criteria of disclosures on store openings.
claims.quote: I mean, it won't be less than 50. I mean, if you're talking so much about it.

claims.description: We hope to continue the acceleration and actually try and open as many more than we have opened in the past.
claims.quote: Like we have always said that the right method of expansion in the offline space is to open on an average every year at least 10% to 15% or maybe 10% to 20% of your base stores – every year.

claims.description: We delivered PAT of INR2,891 crores excluding the tax gain, including tax was about INR2,927 crores.
claims.quote: On a consolidated basis, the sales were about INR59,358 crores and the PAT including tax was about INR2,707 crores at 4.6% margin.

claims.description: We continue to say that India is a huge, huge opportunity from an overall retail space perspective for value retail.
claims.quote: We continue to remain very, very bullish on the offline space and also, we see a lot of opportunities in the online space.

claims.description: We are reasonably pleased with how our private label team is running the business.
claims.quote: But in general, if you want a broad colour, I think, we are reasonably pleased with how our private label team is running the business.

claims.description: We will also play in the online space, but through our own model.
claims.quote: We want to create something which is unique and hard to copy. That's our principle.
